ShortDescription.Value: Export the current city with Carto and explore it in your browser.

Publish.LongDescription:
SKYLENS MAPS opens your city map with **ONE CLICK**.
### Features - Search all buildings, roads, stations and routes in your city - Search driving and transit routes, just like using Google Maps in the real world - View transit layers
### How to Use
- choose Options > SKYLENS MAPS and click LAUNCH SKYLENS MAPS. Done. - The initial map generation may take about 30 seconds
### Required Mods - Carto must be installed
### Korean Description 단 한 번의 클릭으로 지도를 사용해보세요
기능
- 모든 건물, 도로, 대중교통 역/정류장, 도로 검색 - 네이버 지도/구글 지도를 사용하듯 길찾기 - 대중교통 노선 보기
사용법
- 옵션 > SKYLENS MAPS 에서 LAUNCH SKYLENS MAPS 클릭만 하면 끝입니다. - 처음 지도 생성 시 30초 정도 소요됩니다. Route times, stops and transit connections are estimates from exported data, not live game routing. The map is available while the game and mod are running. For limitations, logs and issue reporting, see RELEASE_NOTES.md in the mod package.
The original SKYLENS MAPS code and artwork are licensed under GPL-3.0-only. Corresponding source for 0.1.3 is included as SOURCE.zip in the mod package. Project repository: https://github.com/ganjanggejang/skylens-maps
